**Feature:** Users can upload a profile photo **Safety parts I’ll add right away** - The upload bucket is *private* – only the user who owns the file can see or delete it. - Only JPEG, PNG or GIF files up to 5 MB are allowed. - Every uploaded image is stored in a folder named after the user’s ID so no one else can guess a path. - No photo is ever shown to anyone else unless the user gives explicit permission (not part of the first version). - The photo URL is stored in the user’s Supabase profile record (`avatar_url`). **What we’ll do, step‑by‑step** | Step | What changes | Proof you’ll get to see | Where to save a point | |------|--------------|------------------------|-----------------------| | 1 | Add a new Supabase bucket called `profile-photos` (private) | The bucket appears in the Supabase dashboard with “Not Public” | Git commit `add profile‑photos bucket` | | 2 | Write a **policy** on that bucket to allow only the owner (`user_id`) to read/write | Policy screen shows “Allowed users” list contains `request.auth.uid` | Git commit `add bucket policy` | | 3 | Create a front‑end file‑input component in your Lovable project (HTML/JS or the box you’re using) | You see a button that opens the file picker | Git commit `add photo upload UI` | | 4 | Add JavaScript that:
a) checks file type & size
b) uploads to Supabase storage
c) stores the returned URL in `supabase.auth.user().data` (`avatar_url`) | After selecting a photo, the user’s Supabase profile shows the URL in the console | Git commit `handle upload logic` | | 5 | Add a small CSS rule to display the photo as the avatar on the profile page | Your profile page shows the image instead of a placeholder | Git commit `avatar display` | --- ### Quick check before you do it 1. **Do you already have user login set up?** - If no, you’ll need to enable Supabase Auth (email magic link or password) first. - If yes, we can skip to step 1. 2. **Where do you want the photo to appear first?** - In a “Profile” page you’re already building? - Or on a “Dashboard” or “Settings” page?
